# My Printer Broke - llms.txt

> My Printer Broke is a comprehensive directory of cybersecurity events and curated security news across the United States.

## About

My Printer Broke helps security professionals discover conferences, meetups, workshops, and virtual events in their area, plus a curated feed of cybersecurity and AI security news for MSPs, IT admins, and security practitioners. We aggregate cyber events from major metros including Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Chicago, Miami, Seattle, and more.

## Features

- Browse events by location (city/metro area)
- Filter by format: in-person, virtual, or hybrid
- Filter by type: conferences, meetups, workshops, training
- Browse by category: AppSec, Cloud Security, GRC, Threat Intelligence, etc.
- Curated cybersecurity news from hand-picked sources, updated every 6 hours
- MPB Daily Brief: an original morning digest of the day's security news
- Weekly newsletter with curated events

## Key Pages

- Homepage: https://www.myprinterbroke.com/
- Explore Events: https://www.myprinterbroke.com/events
- News: https://www.myprinterbroke.com/news
- Daily Brief: https://www.myprinterbroke.com/brief
- Submit an Event: https://www.myprinterbroke.com/submit
- Full sitemap: https://www.myprinterbroke.com/sitemap.xml (every event has a dedicated page at /events/[slug])

## Contact

For event submissions or inquiries, visit the site and use the contact form.

## Data

Event data includes: name, date, location, format, type, description, registration links, and pricing information.
